name: Browser screen recording tool with full-resolution input streams

mentions.name: Browser screen recording tool with full-resolution input streams
mentions.description: A browser-based screen recording tool that captures camera and screen. In addition to a combined stream, it records each input stream at full resolution separately, writing files directly to disk to avoid losing data. It only works in Chromium-based browsers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Build a little screen recording tool which apart from combined stream, also gives you the full resolution input streams (camera/screen recording)
